content: When you were born, you cried while the whole village rejoiced; live your life so that when you die, the village weeps while you rejoice.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: Every human enters this world as a helpless, crying babe greeted by the joyful smiles of kin. A life lived with honor, generosity, courage, and unconditional love completes the circle: when the body falls, loved ones weep for the departure of a champion, while your own soul departs in peaceful joy.
practicalInsight: Live with such kindness, honor, and courage today that someone's life is genuinely blessed by your presence.
reflectionPrompt: If your life were to conclude tonight, would your soul depart in joyful peace knowing you lived with full love?
